comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
Slow acceleration, but one will never catch you at the high seas. Good for short travels as well. With the improved version of this ship (Moonlight long schooner), good speed boosters, speed moded, good skills and good sails, i can travel from Boston to Seville in 7 days.

The turning speed isn't a problem for me, because i dont use it for battles, and the travels, even the short ones, dont request lots of turns anyway. Steam engine and emergency acelleration ship skills will cover the low turn speed.
